bindingPanel.description: Once bound, this becomes the entity's default knowledge document source.

documentPicker.autoRuleHint: Using the automatic rule: if the entity has bound documents, use those first; otherwise fall back to all enabled documents.
documentPicker.selectedCount: {{count}} documents selected. Leaving it empty disables knowledge-base retrieval entirely.

page.ragConnCheckFailed: Document retrieval connection check didn't pass.
page.confirmClearJobs: Clear finished task records? Queued and running tasks are kept.
page.confirmDeleteJob: Delete this task record? Queued or running tasks can't be deleted.

detailDialog.expandConfirm: The document has {{count}} characters; opening the full text may make the page lag. Continue?
detailDialog.expandHint: Showing the first {{limit}} characters; click to open the full text ({{count}} characters total)
detailDialog.recallArchivedHint: After re-enabling and indexing, you can test recall effectiveness.
detailDialog.recallInputPlaceholder: Enter a question or excerpt to test the active version's recall effectiveness
detailDialog.recallScopeHint: The recall test only runs on the active, indexed version.
detailDialog.recallNoHits: The current query didn't recall any content chunks.

documentsTab.confirmArchive: Archive "{{title}}"? Archiving removes the document from default retrieval and selection lists; the source and versions are kept and can be re-enabled under "Archived only".
documentsTab.loadingDesc: Confirming document versions and index status.
documentsTab.loadFailTitle: Couldn't load creation documents right now
documentsTab.emptyFilteredDesc: Adjust the keyword or status filter to see other documents.
documentsTab.emptyDesc: After you upload a TXT document, the system builds a retrieval index used for book analysis, planning and writing.
documentsTab.shelfDesc: Pick retrievable documents to keep writing; version and index maintenance is handled when needed.
documentsTab.searchPlaceholder: Search by title or file name
documentsTab.uploadDialogDesc: Add a text document for retrieval, book analysis and reference during writing.
documentsTab.titlePlaceholder: Optional title; blank uses the file name
documentsTab.dropzoneAria: Choose a TXT text document to upload
documentsTab.dropHint: Drag a file here, or click to choose
documentsTab.sameTitleHint: A duplicate title is added as a new version and set as the current version

embeddingSettings.headerDesc: Choose an embedding model and connect the material store so indexed documents can feed book analysis, planning and writing.
embeddingSettings.chooseUnderstandingHint: Use a configured, available provider; the model only understands the document's meaning and doesn't change the source.
embeddingSettings.localModelHint: Use a suggested model first; once the connection works, the list shows the provider's models.
embeddingSettings.vectorApiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
embeddingSettings.vectorApiKeyInputPlaceholder: Enter the embedding service API key
embeddingSettings.vectorApiUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank to use the provider's default URL
embeddingSettings.connScopeHint: This connection is only for understanding documents; it doesn't change the creation model, default model or task routing.
embeddingSettings.connectStoreHint: Supports Qdrant Cloud, self-hosted Qdrant or a local material store.
embeddingSettings.storeUrlHint: The local address is usually http://127.0.0.1:6333; for cloud, enter the full URL.
embeddingSettings.storeApiKeyKeepPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the saved key
embeddingSettings.storeApiKeyInputPlaceholder: Enter the vector store API key
embeddingSettings.clearStoreApiKey: Clear the saved vector store API key on save
embeddingSettings.advancedHint: Collection version v{{version}} · collection naming, re-indexing, retrieval quality and background task parameters
embeddingSettings.collectionSectionHint: Auto-naming distinguishes collections by provider, model, tag and version to reduce vector-dimension conflict risk.
embeddingSettings.collectionTagHint: Use a short tag to distinguish environments or data groups.
embeddingSettings.autoReindex: Auto re-index after the embedding changes
embeddingSettings.connWriteSectionHint: Defaults suit most knowledge bases; adjust only when the connection is slow, batch writes fail, or you need to pause retrieval.
embeddingSettings.upsertConcurrencyHint: Max concurrent chunk batches sent to Qdrant. Default 3; raise to 4-6 for large documents to speed up.
embeddingSettings.retrievalTuningHint: When retrieval isn't precise enough or you need to control latency, adjust chunk size and candidate counts.
embeddingSettings.embeddingBehaviorHint: For large bulk imports or slow service responses, adjust batch size, timeout, retry count and polling parameters.
embeddingSettings.embeddingConcurrencyHint: Concurrent embedding API requests. Default 4; raising it can noticeably cut large-document indexing time but must respect provider quotas.
embeddingSettings.saveHint: After saving, newly created or re-indexed documents use this retrieval configuration.

libraryOverview.recErrorDesc: Couldn't read the document list right now. Reloading won't change existing documents or index tasks.
libraryOverview.recLoadingDesc: Organizing document status and index results; once loaded, it suggests an actionable next step.
libraryOverview.recActiveJobsDesc: {{count}} index tasks are running; you can view progress. Prefer indexed documents when writing.
libraryOverview.recFailedDesc: Some documents aren't fully indexed. Review the failure reasons and rebuild the index first; other usable documents can still feed creation.
libraryOverview.recNoMatchDesc: The current search or status has no matches; clear filters to return to the full document list.
libraryOverview.recEmptyDesc: Upload a TXT document; the system indexes it for book analysis, planning and writing.
libraryOverview.recNotSearchableDesc: The list has no enabled, indexed document. Pick one to enable or rebuild its index before it can feed creation.
libraryOverview.recReadyDesc: {{count}} documents can feed retrieval. View versions, run recall tests, or pick documents to keep writing.
libraryOverview.headerDesc: Centrally manage reusable creation documents, confirm index status, then feed reliable content into book analysis, planning and writing.

opsTab.healthyDesc: The embedding model and material store connection are normal; indexed documents can feed book analysis, planning and writing.
opsTab.unhealthyDesc: The embedding model or material store connection has an error; once fixed, document indexing and recall can continue.
opsTab.jobsDesc: View documents entering the retrieval store; failure reasons show directly, operational details expand when needed.
opsTab.emptyDesc: After uploading documents or rebuilding the index, you can view progress here.
